info.title: Forge configuration JSON-RPC
info.description: Single-call JSON-RPC 2.0 subset. No batches, notifications, positional params or null IDs. A successful authenticated POST returns one JSON-RPC response with the request ID and exactly one result or error. Invalid IDs and parse errors use null. This POC is not a production service.

x-security.description: Supply one Authorization: Bearer <token> header. The token is an encrypted per-environment Forge runtime variable (RPC_BEARER_SECRET), issued only to approved test operators. The public URL alone grants no access.

nonRpcErrors.503: Service Unavailable when the bearer secret is not configured

methods.name: config.get
methods.summary: Read the saved non-secret prefix or the unconfigured state.

methods.name: config.set
methods.summary: Trim and persist a non-secret prefix in installation-scoped Forge KVS.
methods.description: The trimmed value must contain 1 to 64 Unicode code points. Only the prefix is stored. Extra parameters are rejected.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Validated after trimming; length counts Unicode code points.
